title: Village
tagline: All-in-one DAO management tool to enable aggregation of all tools.
description: This platform sits on top of a variety of different tools including discourse, snapshot, SAFE (tresury data), internal documents and much more. `The objective is to ensure that the DAO core team and community can have one location that centralizes all their tools and streamlines the entire process.
how_its_made: This project is made with a combination of frontend and design. It uses and focuses on Figma to curate the design experience with Next.js, Tailwindcss and TypeScript to provide the visual frontend. To ensure a real example, we focused our efforts on ApeCoin which indicated a variety of pain points.
